name: recent_changes
description: Check whether the Emirates travel advisory has CHANGED recently. A context.dev monitor watches the page and pushes changes to us, so this reports what moved and how many minutes ago — which no other tool can tell you. Call this when a caller asks 'is that still true?', 'has anything changed?', 'how current is this?', when they say they were told something different earlier, or before giving a final answer on a decision that matters (whether to leave for the airport). If `changed` is false, say plainly that nothing has changed and the answer stands.

within_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes. Defaults to 120.
